run_poly_seq2seq_training: run poly tuning for sequence-to-sequence models on SuperGLUE tasks using GaudiSeq2SeqTrainer on HPU
create_poly_config: create a PolyConfig with task type SEQ_2_SEQ_LM, rank, skills, and splits for PEFT poly tuning
build_superglue_dataset: build a combined SuperGLUE dataset from boolq, multirc, rte, and wic tasks with tokenization and task IDs
generate_with_peft_model: generate predictions from a PEFT poly-tuned seq2seq model using task_ids on HPU with torch.no_grad
configure_gaudi_trainer: configure a GaudiSeq2SeqTrainer with fused Adam, fused clip norm, and PEFT model for HPU training
